policies.title: RDS storage encryption
policies.description: Require explicit storage encryption for supported AWS RDS instances and clusters, including resolvable cluster members.
policies.scope_description: Standalone RDS instances and RDS clusters; Aurora members inherit only from a unique same-plan cluster with known matching identifier and AWS ARN context. Unresolved associations are indeterminate; service defaults and live state are not inferred.

policies.title: Unrestricted SSH ingress
policies.description: Detect observed ingress rules permitting direct TCP SSH from an individual world-wide IPv4 or IPv6 CIDR.
policies.scope_description: Observed inline ingress and standalone ingress rules only. Prefix-list contents remain unresolved; live reachability and unions of narrower CIDRs are not analyzed.
